title.narrative: Minorities and Refugees Lead, Engage and Advocate for Democracy and Rights in T¿rkiye

description.narrative:
The Overall Objective is to promote and protect the rights and fundamental freedoms of vulnerable groups and minorities in Türkiye through directly supporting independent local civil society organisations (CSOs) working on human rights through inclusion and participation.

The Specific Objective is to enable local independent CSOs working with vulnerable groups and minorities, more specifically Kurds, Syrians and Arabs in Gaziantep, Mardin and Sanliurfa, to enhance their inclusion and participation in public and political processes through training, coaching, sub-granting and networking and through evidence-based advocacy for change, informed by the target communities.
